prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Rimeholt: a sheltering holt among frost-coated trees, a tarn and a glacier under a pale sky. A quiet, crystalline theme with harp and gentle bowed strings. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
